toolkits.description: Read retained company evidence or collect a targeted refresh.
Create or operate one evidence-backed Growth Stage and Work Order.
Retrieve selected company facts, policies, and prior decisions.
Read and append compact operating checkpoints.
Delegate bounded specialist work and inspect result packets.
Create, schedule, inspect, pause, or operate campaign actions.
Inspect connected social state and execute approved channel actions.
Inspect website evidence and delegate prioritized SEO work.
Render/crawl a specific public URL (optionally reusing a pre-authorized session for a gated platform) or run a live web search; delegate to a Room for rendered text, links, SEO meta, or a screenshot.
Read organization leads and persist newly verified prospects.
Prepare or execute approved outreach actions.
Create durable HQ checkpoints and event-driven wakes.
Evaluate policy, approval, claim, spending, and external-write constraints.
